summary: Iteration 4 (NPSI host search/filter) fully validated. Backend: 32/32 pytest tests pass, including new TestHosts (shape, sorted, expected slugs 'fun-inc' & 'bombers-bar', absolute logos, /api/hosts/fun-inc returns provider F.U.N. Inc. with 622 in reports, /api/hosts/does-not-exist-xyz -> 404). All previous iterations (universe, /api/report/622, /api/reports/recent, /api/report/combined) still green. Frontend: Recent panel opens, host-search-input present; typing 'bomber' opens host-menu with host-option-bombers-bar; clicking loads Bombers Bar's 6 reports and panel header shows 'Bombers Bar'; host-clear-btn resets to global 'Recent Roams'. Host-filtered rows retain recent-report-<id> and group-check-<id> selectors — clicking loads report (Wednesday Whaling); ticking 2 host reports + Combine builds combined-fleets block with 'Combined · 2 fleets'. Regression: replay-roam-btn hidden for combined, timeline-panel hidden for combined, both reappear after reloading single report 622.

issues: Recharts 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warning persists on first paint (pre-existing, cosmetic).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/hosts/{slug}: relies on NPSI 404 propagation via _fetch_json; verified working (404 for unknown slug). No input validation on slug format, but NPSI upstream handles it.

FleetMap selectHost: when switching hosts, existing groupIds are cleared (good) but if user had a combined report loaded, that report state persists on screen until they pick a new one. Consider clearing report or hint UI. Minor UX only.
RecentRoams host dropdown menu (host-menu) has no explicit outside-click close handler; clicking outside doesn't dismiss it (only picking a host or clearing does). Minor UX polish.
Iteration-3 comments still apply: no visible max-ticks-8 guard; combined view can linger if user re-submits the same reportId (reportId state unchanged so effect doesn't refire).
seed_data_creation: None; live NPSI API. Host tests use stable slug 'fun-inc' + report 622. Frontend combine test dynamically picked first two bombers-bar reports (ids observed at runtime: 610, 577).
